trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: If you had planted trees, we have shade now.
trap.right: If you had planted trees, we would have shade now.
trap.why: Condicional misto: passado → presente: if + had + particípio, would + base. O brasileiro mistura have/would have.

mcq.q: If you had planted trees, we **___** shade now.
If I were taller, I **___** have joined.
If she had studied, she **___** a doctor now.

fix.wrong: If I had listened, I would be lost now.
fix.right: If I had listened, I wouldn’t be lost now.

fix.wrong: If you had took the job, you would be rich.
fix.right: If you had taken the job, you would be rich.

fix.wrong: If you had left, you will be home now.
fix.right: If you had left, you would be home now.

rewrite.prompt: Combine: “I didn’t plant trees, so we have no shade.”
rewrite.answer: If I had planted trees, we would have shade.

rewrite.prompt: Combine: “She didn’t study, so she isn’t a doctor.”
rewrite.answer: If she had studied, she would be a doctor.

rewrite.prompt: Inverta as cláusulas: “If you had left, you would be home now.”
rewrite.answer: You would be home now if you had left.
